name: Cjeese Popcorn
ingredients_raw: POPCORN SACHET: Popping Corn (70%), Edible Vegetable Oil (Rice Bran Oil), Iodized Salt, Rosemary Extract (INS 392). INGREDIENTS SEASONING SACHET: Maltodextrin, Wheat flour (atta), Whey (from milk), Edible vegetable oil (sunflower oil), Sugar, Iodized salt, Spice extract, sodium phosphate (INS 339), Citric acid (INS 330), Lactic acid (INS 270), Autolysed yeast extract, Spice, Cheddar cheese, Butter enzyme, Natural flavour (milk), Modified starch (INS 1420). CONTAINS ADDED FLAVOURS (NATURAL AND NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES)
